interpretations: Group signals by `rfistat`, including NULL as one group. Return groups whose average non-NULL `modindex` exceeds the average across all signals with a non-NULL `modindex`. Show each group’s average, its signed difference from that overall average, and its signed difference from the unweighted mean of the returned groups’ averages
Use the same groups and overall signal average, but report each group’s percentage above that average and its percentage difference from the mean of the returned groups’ averages

Group signals by `rfistat`, including NULL as one group. Return groups whose average non-NULL `modindex` exceeds the unweighted mean of all groups’ averages. Show each group’s average, its signed difference from that mean, and its signed difference from the unweighted mean of the returned groups’ averages
Use the same unweighted mean of all groups’ averages to select groups, but report percentage differences for both comparisons
Under either group selection rule, interpret “how it differs from the mean of the qualifying statuses’ averages” as an absolute difference rather than a signed difference

Select signals with a non-NULL `modindex` above the overall signal average, then group those signals by `rfistat` (including NULL). Show each group’s average and its differences from the overall average and the mean of the returned groups’ averages
queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS group_average
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
returned_groups AS (
  SELECT rfistat, group_average
  FROM group_averages
  WHERE group_average > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals)
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  group_average,
  group_average - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals) AS difference_from_overall,
  group_average - (SELECT AVG(group_average) FROM returned_groups) AS difference_from_returned_groups
FROM returned_groups

WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
all_groups_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS mean_avg_modindex
    FROM group_averages
),
returned_groups AS (
    SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - a.mean_avg_modindex AS difference_from_all
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN all_groups_mean AS a
    WHERE g.avg_modindex > a.mean_avg_modindex
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    difference_from_all,
    avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_returned
FROM returned_groups

WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
),
groups AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS group_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    AND modindex > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall)
  GROUP BY rfistat
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  group_avg,
  group_avg - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall) AS difference_from_overall,
  group_avg - AVG(group_avg) OVER () AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM groups
